files.help.title: File Explorer
files.help.intro: File Explorer lets you browse and organize your project files without leaving the console. You can preview, download, upload, and manage folders from one screen.
files.help.first.title: First steps
files.help.first.step1: Choose Home, the main project, or Trash in the sidebar.
files.help.first.step2: Double-click a folder to enter it; use the breadcrumbs above or Back to return.
files.help.first.step3: Click once to select and double-click to open a folder or preview a file.
files.help.first.step4: Use the top bar to change the view, upload files, create a folder, or refresh.
files.help.first.step5: Right-click to open the context menu and download, rename, or send a selection to Trash.

files.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
files.help.buttons.back.v: Go up to the previous folder or jump directly to a level in the path.
files.help.buttons.places.v: Jump to your files, the main project, or deleted items.
files.help.buttons.claude.v: Opens a Claude session in the current folder; the session consumes tokens while it works.
files.help.buttons.terminal.v: Opens a terminal in the current folder; it does not consume AI tokens by itself.
files.help.buttons.views.v: Switches between thumbnails and a table sortable by name, type, size, or date.
files.help.buttons.upload.v: Copies one or more files into the current folder; if a name already exists, it creates a unique one instead of overwriting it.
files.help.buttons.drop.v: Uploads files dropped onto the main area of the current folder.
files.help.buttons.mkdir.v: Creates a new folder with the name you provide.
files.help.buttons.refresh.v: Reads the folder contents from disk again.
files.help.buttons.selection.v: One click selects one; Ctrl/Cmd toggles items and Shift selects a range.
files.help.buttons.preview.v: Opens images, audio, video, PDF, or text; binary and very large files must be downloaded.
files.help.buttons.download.v: Downloads a file, a folder as ZIP, or a multi-selection in one ZIP.
files.help.buttons.rename.v: Changes the name on disk; it may break links or processes that depend on the old path.
files.help.buttons.trash.v: Moves the selection to Trash; it can be restored for 30 days.
files.help.buttons.restore.v: Returns an item from Trash to its original location.
files.help.buttons.purge.v: Deletes the item permanently. This is destructive and cannot be undone.
files.help.buttons.keys.v: Enter opens; Delete or Backspace sends the selection to Trash; Esc closes menus and previews.
files.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
files.help.warning.text: Trash is recoverable: it keeps items in ~/.cwc-trash/ for 30 days and then purges them. “Delete” inside Trash is immediate and irreversible; renaming also changes the real path used by links, scripts, and sessions.
